anti_overlap: Focus on integration plumbing, not cost routing decisions (fd-heterogeneous-fleet-cost-routing) or prompt portability (fd-prompt-portability-across-families)
decision_lens: Does the integration preserve interflux's progressive enhancement contract — OpenRouter as optional acceleration, never a gate?
focus: Architectural correctness of wiring OpenRouter as a Bash-tool HTTP backend into interflux's pipeline
name: fd-openrouter-dispatch-integration
persona: An integration architect who has built multi-provider AI gateways and knows exactly where HTTP dispatch backends break when grafted onto Agent-tool pipelines
review_areas: HTTP dispatch backend architecture: curl/httpie calls via Bash tool vs dedicated MCP server for OpenRouter
Token accounting across backends: how billing tokens from OpenRouter map to interflux's budget.yaml cost model
Context window management per model family: DeepSeek V3 (128K) vs Qwen 2.5 (128K) vs Claude (200K) prompt construction
Progressive enhancement gate: what happens when OpenRouter is unavailable — silent fallback to Claude-only or hard failure?
Response format normalization: converting OpenRouter JSON responses to match interflux's findings index contract

severity_examples.condition: When HTTP response is 200 but body contains an error object instead of completion
severity_examples.scenario: OpenRouter dispatch fails silently and produces no findings, but orchestrator counts the agent as complete

severity_examples.condition: When budget.yaml cost_basis doesn't distinguish provider
severity_examples.scenario: Token accounting double-counts: OpenRouter tokens recorded as Claude billing tokens in cost report

severity_examples.condition: When slicing thresholds are calibrated for Claude's context limit only
severity_examples.scenario: Context overflow on DeepSeek when prompt exceeds 128K but interflux assumes 200K Claude window

success_hints: Look for explicit provider abstraction layer, response normalization contract, and graceful degradation when OpenRouter is unreachable
task_context: Interflux currently dispatches all agents via Claude Code's Agent tool. Adding OpenRouter requires a parallel dispatch path through Bash or MCP.
